description:
Goal
Restore the native selective-receive continuation contract for fixtures2/behavior/receive_selective_refs.fz.

Baseline proof
A clean detached worktree at integration parent f8a7557a0 reproduces both failures with `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/fz-1ah-parent-target cargo test --test fz2_cli receive_fixtures -- --nocapture`. `run_and_interp_execute_receive_fixtures` and `build_executes_receive_fixtures` both panic at native_codegen/terminator.rs: continuation callee 32 has 1 logical argument but 2 published parameter representations. The fz-1ah.12 candidate reproduces the same invariant with telemetry absent, proving .12 did not introduce it. Closed fz-go4.10 intended to fix this surface, so this is a regression follow-up.

Strategy
Reopen the data-model seam behind fz-go4.10 rather than weakening the invariant. Spike first: trace the selective-receive outcome closure and logical delivery arguments from their last authoritative representation through transport publication to native continuation consumption. Only refine preserved authority; do not infer or reconstruct arguments from downstream representations. Then implement the smallest source-model correction that makes the invariant true by construction.

Acceptance
Both exact CLI tests pass for run, interp, and build. The logical-argument/published-representation invariant remains enforced. No telemetry compensation, fixture exception, reverse engineering, or duplicated ABI representation is introduced. Full library and strict lint gates remain green.
title: Restore selective-receive continuation delivery contract
